"

Let's craft.

Check for accidental uppercase: "Matthias" capital M but not all caps, fine. "Algiers" capital A but not all caps. "Summary" capital S but not all caps. We need to avoid any word that is all caps besides our selected ones. So we must ensure no other words like "AND", "OR", "THE", etc are all caps. We'll keep them lowercase.

We need to watch for "I" as a word; uppercase I is a single letter word all caps. That would count as uppercase word. So we must avoid the word "I". Use "I" maybe as pronoun; but that's uppercase single letter I, which is all caps. That would violate constraint. So we need to avoid using the word "I". Use "me" or avoid first-person pronouns. Use third-person style? In resume we often use bullet points without pronouns. So we can avoid "I". Good.

Also avoid "A" as word? "A" is uppercase single letter; that would count. So we need to avoid the word "A" as a standalone word. Use "an" instead. Also avoid "AN"? "AN" is uppercase if capitalized? We'll use lowercase "an". So we must ensure we don't accidentally have uppercase "A" or "I". We'll write sentences without those as separate words. Use "an" lowercase.

Also avoid "USA" etc.
